name: Bouffalant
description: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers the Defense stat.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.description: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.description: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Horn Attack
moves.description: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.

moves.name: Head Charge
moves.description: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.description: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user moves after the target, this attack’s power will be doubled.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.description: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Retaliate
moves.description: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this move’s power is increased.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Work Up
moves.description: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.

moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user’s previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

moves.name: Lash Out
moves.description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If the user’s stats were lowered during this turn, the power of this move is doubled.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.description: The target is stomped with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Skull Bash
moves.description: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: This attack move cuts down the target’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Cotton Guard
moves.description: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, which drastically raises the user’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Belch
moves.description: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
